routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of a long list of countries can enter Kosovo without a visa, usually for up to 90 days in any 6-month period. The list includes the EU/Schengen states, the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan and Albania.

other: Official list is longer than this. Check the MFA list for your passport.
Taiwan passport holders get 90 days visa-free but must notify Kosovo's diplomatic posts before travel.
Stay limit was only stated on the MFA visa page, and the archived MFA list page gives no stay limit, so confirm before you go.

stay.note: Most visa-free nationals. Valid travel document needed.

routes.name: Visa-free entry for Schengen residents and some document holders
routes.summary: If you normally need a visa, you can still enter for up to 15 days with a valid biometric residence permit or multi-entry visa from a Schengen state. Some refugee and stateless travel documents also count.

other: Valid biometric Schengen residence permit or valid multi-entry Schengen visa.

Also covers UN, NATO, OSCE, Council of Europe and EU laissez-passer, and travel documents issued under the 1951 Refugee or 1954 Stateless Persons conventions by EU/Schengen states, US, Canada, Australia or Japan.

sources.label: Kosovo MFA: who needs a visa

routes.name: Short-stay visa (and transit visa)
routes.summary: Nationals of countries not on the visa-free list need a visa to visit or transit Kosovo. You apply at Kosovo's diplomatic posts in Tirana or Istanbul.

other: Fees, processing time and full document list were not on the official pages we could read. Ask the Tirana or Istanbul post.

steps: Check if your passport is on the visa-required list.
Contact the Kosovo post in Tirana (visa.al@rks-gov.net) or Istanbul (visa.ist@rks-gov.net).

sources.label: Kosovo MFA: who needs a visa

routes.name: Temporary residence permit: employment
routes.summary: Temporary residence for people working in Kosovo, including business owners. You need a contract under Kosovo labor law (not required for business owners), enough money to live on, and health insurance.

other: Valid travel document, valid at least 3 months beyond the requested stay.
Proof of education and qualifications (not required for business owners).
Certificate showing no pending investigations, translated.
Business registration details.
No entry ban.
NGO staff under the annual employment quota give the NGO registration certificate instead of the housing proof.
Permit length was not stated on the page.

steps: Prepare the employment checklist (Albanian, Serbian or English version on the MPB page).
Translate foreign documents into an official language of Kosovo.
Apply at the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
Renew online through eKosova, within 30 days before the permit expires.

sources.label: MPB: Temporary residence permit for foreigners

routes.name: Temporary residence permit: family reunification
routes.summary: Temporary residence for family of a Kosovo citizen or sponsor. Cohabiting partners can show 3 years living together or a child's birth certificate.

other: Proof of family relationship (marriage, family community, birth, adoption or guardianship papers).
ID of the sponsor.
Enough means to live on and adequate housing.
Health insurance.
Translated certificate showing no criminal conviction.
No entry ban.
Valid travel document, valid at least 3 months beyond the requested stay.

sources.label: MPB: Temporary residence permit for foreigners

routes.name: Temporary residence permit: study and research
routes.summary: Temporary residence for pre-university students, university students, exchange and internship participants, and scientific researchers.

other: Proof of enrollment in a Kosovo school or higher education institution.
Notarized proof of enough means, or coverage by the exchange organization.
Proof of accommodation and health insurance.
Minors need notarized parent or guardian consent.
Researchers need an invitation from a licensed Kosovo institution and a research agreement.
No entry ban.

sources.label: MPB: Temporary residence permit for foreigners

routes.name: Permanent residence permit
routes.summary: Permanent residence after 5 years of uninterrupted temporary residence, or 3 years if you came through marriage or cohabitation. You also pass a written test on an official language and Kosovo's culture.

eligibility.language: Elementary written knowledge of Albanian or Serbian, plus a test on Kosovo culture and social order
other: Exempt from the test: preschool children, people who finished school in Kosovo, unemployed people over 65, and native speakers of an official language.
No Kosovo court conviction, enough money to live on, health insurance, secured housing.
The minimum amount of living funds is in a PDF on the MPB page, not read here.
